facts.fact: 父亲以「搬出家门」相威胁，逼 15 岁的作者随全家去 Rockaway 海滩度假
facts.anchor: My dad gave me an ultimatum—to come with them or move out of their house altogether.

facts.fact: 救生员 Peter 在众人面前把 Barbara 拖进海里扒掉泳衣
facts.anchor: but he followed her and wrestled her in the ocean, forcibly stripping her of her bathing suit

facts.fact: 母亲目睹 Barbara 事件后断言作者永远不会成为救生员
facts.anchor: “Jesus, Mary, and Joseph,” she said. “You’ll never be a lifeguard.”

facts.fact: 表姐 Patricia 在 Sandy Hook 被浪拍进沙里，摔断锁骨
酒吧里 Tom 拉下作者的上衣，作者脱下 Dr. Scholl's 拖鞋砸他的头
facts.anchor: one of them—Tom—had pulled my tube top down

facts.fact: 母亲替楼里的朝鲜族与叙利亚家庭担保移民签证
facts.anchor: my mother sponsored all of their immigration visas

facts.fact: 母亲反对之下，作者 19 岁才报名当救生员
facts.anchor: I was the ripe old age of nineteen when I first signed up

facts.fact: 两人被派驻 Rockaway 西端的 Belle Harbor（135 至 149 街）
facts.anchor: We were sent to Belle Harbor, a stretch of the beach from 135th to 149th Streets
